axis: Leaf axis: none.

axis: Leaf axis: daily task or care need.

name: Medicines
axis: Leaf axis: symptom or condition group (the one place in H2 where condition is the leaf axis). All medicines are here, prescription or not. The kind is the labelled use class. name: Supplements
axis: Leaf axis: ingredient class. A single-ingredient product is the kind named by its ingredient; a product that mixes ingredient classes is a multi-ingredient supplement. name: Sports, meal and medical nutrition
axis: Leaf axis: role in training or meals. Sports and meal-replacement products are here in every form (powders, bars, gels, ready-to-drink shakes, tablets).

name: Contraception, barriers and breastfeeding
axis: Leaf axis: purpose, to prevent pregnancy or infection, or to feed. Tests are in H2.1 and medicines in H2.6.

name: First aid and wound care
axis: Leaf axis: form of supply.

name: Supports, braces and prostheses
axis: Leaf axis: what the object does to the body part. Body region is part of the kind name.

name: Parts and accessories made for one device
axis: Leaf axis: device family served. This sub-family is exempt from the sub-family axis above.

name: Walking aids (ordered by support given, least to most)
Vision (ordered worn, then held, then on the eye, then the cane)
Templates and production packs

name: Domain names

name: Tokens
axis: Kind axis: token form (I2-O1); token standards, then NFT collections (maker-bound), are named forms.

name: Rice, grains & flours
axis: Leaf axis: the grain and its form as sold, an ordered key, first yes: (1) milled to flour or meal: Flours & meals; (2) a rice grain, whole or flattened: Rice; (3) oats, or a cereal made to eat at breakfast: Oats & breakfast cereals; (4) otherwise: Other grains, pseudo-cereals & starch pearls.

name: Pasta & noodles
axis: Leaf axis: the dough base, an ordered key, first yes: (1) potato dough: Gnocchi; (2) buckwheat in the dough: Buckwheat noodles; (3) egg dough: Egg pasta & egg noodles; (4) rice flour or a pure starch (mung bean, potato): Rice & starch noodles; (5) durum wheat semolina, including whole-wheat durum: Durum wheat pasta; (6) soft wheat flour: Soft-wheat noodles; (7) any other flour: Other-flour pasta & noodles. Fresh or dried is the attribute `storage_state`. Cuts within a shape family (spaghetti, penne, fusilli) are named forms of the family kind; a maker line is a maker-bound named form with its cut recorded (J-1).

name: Pulses
axis: Leaf axis: the species group. Whole or split (dal), dried or tinned, and cooked plain in water or brine are attributes: a dried and a tinned pulse of one species are one kind. Heirloom varieties are named forms.

name: Nuts & seeds
axis: Leaf axis: the plant group of the nut or seed. Form (in shell, shelled, blanched, flaked, ground), roasting and salting are attributes, so ground almonds are almonds. Every nut, chestnut and coconut is here (K-54).

name: Oils, fats & vinegars
axis: Leaf axis: the kind of product: plant oil, solid fat, vinegar or cooking liquid.

name: Spices, herbs & salt
axis: Leaf axis: the form of the seasoning: single spice, dried herb, blend, salt.

name: Sugars, honey & syrups
axis: Leaf axis: the sweetener type.

name: Spreads, pastes & dips
axis: Leaf axis: the kind of spread. A spread, paste or dip eaten with other food is here whatever it is made from, except spreads and fresh cheeses made from milk (J3) (K-44).

name: Sauces, condiments & stocks
axis: Leaf axis: the product type as standards and shelves class it, an ordered key, first yes: (1) a soy sauce: Soy sauces; (2) another seasoning made by fermenting beans, grain or fish: Other fermented seasonings; (3) a stock or bouillon in any form: Stocks & bouillon; (4) a paste used as a cooking ingredient: Cooking & seasoning pastes; (5) a sauce to cook with or pour over pasta: Cooking & pasta sauces; (6) otherwise: Table sauces, condiments & dressings.

name: Baking ingredients
axis: Leaf axis: the function in the bake or the brew. Holds only products no other family holds; flour, sugar and nuts stay in their own families.

name: Tofu, tempeh & meat alternatives
axis: Leaf axis: how the protein food is made, an ordered key, first yes: (1) texturised or formed to imitate a meat product: Plant-based meat analogues; (2) washed from wheat dough: Seitan & wheat gluten; (3) a whole bean fermented: Tempeh & fermented beans; (4) set as a curd: Tofu & bean-curd products. Firmness and format are attributes.

name: Calf (to the calf, below the knee)
Slippers (soft, unstructured footwear without a rigid or moulded outsole: the sole is a thin, flexible layer of felt, fabric, leather, suede, foam or thin rubber; no leaf)
Over-footwear (worn over another shoe to cover the foot; no leaf)
Parts and accessories made for one pair of shoes (no leaf)
Abrasives cut for one power tool
Tops

name: Bottoms

axis: Leaf axis: garment form (dress or two-piece set; one-piece work or play garment; tailored set; draped or wrapped length).

name: Outerwear
axis: Leaf axis: silhouette: sleeved and hip length or shorter; sleeved and below the hip; sleeveless; cape form.

axis: Leaf axis: garment form family (worn under; worn on legs and feet; worn to sleep or lounge; worn in or beside water).

name: Parts and accessories made for one garment
axis: Leaf axis: object served: the garment served; provisional and small; kinds ordered by the garment they serve.

name: Computers
axis: Leaf axis: none (9 kinds, C5(b)). Kind order: current machines as shops list them (laptop, then desktop forms from large to small), then the build-it-yourself body and the single-board computer, then the historic classes, which carry an era tag.

name: PC parts
axis: Leaf axis: build slot, the parts list a builder fills, in the order of PCPartPicker's list (CPU, CPU cooler, motherboard, memory, storage, video card, case, power supply) [S01], then the expansion cards and internal cables that UK and Japanese shops carry in the same parts tree [S02, S06]. Compatibility codes (socket, chipset, DDR and PCIe generation, M.2 length, board, case and PSU form factor) are attributes, not kinds.

name: Peripherals and desk setup
axis: Leaf axis: device family on the desk (what the user handles or sets up beside the computer), with the mechanical-keyboard hobby's kits and parts as their own shelf beside keyboards, as keyboard shops show them (keyboards, kits, switches, keycaps, plates and stabilisers).

name: Printing and scanning
axis: Leaf axis: none (8 kinds, C5(b)). Kind order: machines (printing on paper, scanning, then 3D printing), then the supplies made for them, which shops sell in the same aisle ("printers, ink and toner").

name: External storage and media
axis: Leaf axis: none (9 kinds, C5(b)). Kind order: external drives, carried flash media, readers and housings, network storage, then disc and legacy drives.

name: Networking and backup power
axis: Leaf axis: none (8 kinds, C5(b)). Kind order: the path from the provider's line to the devices (modem, router, wireless coverage, wired distribution, power over the network), then the UPS that keeps the setup running.

name: Cables, adapters and chargers
axis: Leaf axis: none (10 kinds, C5(b); connector family becomes the leaf axis if harvest takes the sub-family above about 12 kinds). Kind order: cables by connector family (data and video, network, audio and music), then adapters and hubs, then generic chargers.

name: Electronics and maker parts
axis: Leaf axis: component family as the distributor catalogue groups it, maker boards and kits first (provisional until the Mouser harvest; loose components are carried to the Mouser class level).

name: Point of sale and security devices

This sub-family is not in the owner's list of eight: the key names these objects for D1 and none of the eight aisles is where a buyer looks for them (shops sell them as a point-of-sale aisle and as security keys).

name: Parts and accessories made for one computer or peripheral

name: Implements & hardware

name: Pipes

name: Water pipes

name: Vape & heating hardware
axis: Kind axis: device architecture, simplest first (provisional: a comparison source is still needed, C10(b)). Display group: Vapes and e-liquids; the heated-tobacco device in Heated tobacco; the vaporizer in Cannabis and hemp.

name: Lighters

name: Rolling & grinding
axis: Kind axis: the object itself. Display group: Cigarettes and roll-your-own; the grinder in Cannabis and hemp.

name: Cutters, ashtrays & carry
axis: Kind axis: the object itself. Display group: Lighters, cutters, ashtrays and cases; the cigar cutter, cigar case and travel humidor are also shown in Cigars and cigarillos.

name: Parts and accessories made for one B9 object (no leaf)
Fresh & frozen meat
axis: Leaf axis: the animal (raw muscle, bone, offal, mince and shaped raw mince, chilled or frozen). Offal sits under each animal (J-3). Kind: the animal and its named retail cut (J-1); a cut enters as a kind on one fetched page showing it sold. Order inside a leaf (memo section 8): whole-muscle steak and roast cuts front to back along the carcass, then kinds sold whole, then primals or sides, then mince, then shaped raw mince, then offal.

name: Cured, smoked & dried whole-muscle meats
axis: Leaf axis: cure class (raw-cured; cooked-cured; dried and jerked; cured fat; pickled and fermented). A whole muscle or piece cured, smoked, dried or pickled, raw or cured then cooked, sold as a piece or sliced. The sale name, seal colour and size of piece are attributes. Order inside a leaf: the canonical dry-cured ham first, then the other pieces front to back (jowl, neck, shoulder, loin, belly, then cured beef).

name: Sausages
axis: Leaf axis: process class (fresh, to be cooked; dry-cured and fermented; scalded; cooked, liver and blood). Comminuted meat in a casing or formed as a sausage. Order: by process class, then the canonical form of the class first. Regional varieties (Cumberland, Milano, Toscana) are named forms.

name: Tea
axis: Leaf axis: tea type by processing (ISO 20715), in order of oxidation: white, green, yellow, oolong, black, dark, then reprocessed. Inside a leaf with more than one kind, the kind axis is the process that defines the tea; region, cultivar, leaf grade and shop category are never the kind axis (J-15, review J6-6).

name: Green tea
axis: Kind axis: the defining process (steaming, shading then steaming, pan-firing, roasting, grinding).

name: Herbal & other infusions
axis: Leaf axis: plant part infused (not Camellia sinensis). Kind: the herb or plant (J-15); kinds alphabetical by English name inside a leaf (memo section 8). A blend with one plant at half its weight or more is filed under that plant's kind (K-46).

name: Catalogue and play access
axis: Leaf axis: the medium of the catalogue. Kind axis inside a leaf: how the catalogue is offered (on-demand library, live or linear, periodical delivery, season pass); for periodicals, how many titles the plan holds (print or digital is the plan attribute `delivery`); in Several media, whether the plan bundles several services or gives one creator's mixed feed. Order (memo section 8): on-demand library before live or linear before periodical delivery; one-title periodical before many-title library.

name: Member places and passes
axis: Leaf axis: what the member does there. Kind axis: the way of entering. The type of site or activity (heritage, museum, zoo, tennis, golf) is a tag, never a kind.

name: Cutting & pruning
axis: Leaf axis: the thing cut (branches, hedges, grass and brush). Kind axis: tool or machine form, in order of working scale; `drive`, cutting action, capacity and the battery system (a C13 row) are attributes.

name: Lawn, turf & ground cover
axis: Leaf axis: the lawn operation (mow, edge, renovate, feed and roll), then the surface laid. Kind axis: machine or product form, in operation order, then size; `drive`, propulsion, cutting width, mulching and collecting are attributes, `lawn_area_suited` an attribute of mower named forms.

name: Watering & irrigation
axis: Leaf axis: the role in the water path (carry, spray, control, hand-water, pump, hold), from source to plant. Kind axis: component or device type; sprinkler head type and the system line are attributes or lines, the system platform a C13 row.

name: Pots, containers, supports & covers
axis: Leaf axis: what it does for the plant (hold the roots, support the shoot, cover the plant). Kind axis: container or support form, by size; material, colour, volume and frost-hardiness are attributes, except where the material makes the form. Choice level provisional (no "best pot" list fetched).

name: Soil, feed & plant protection
axis: Leaf axis: the product function (growing medium, feed, plant protection, applicator or test, composting), in function order. Kind axis: product function; formulation, nutrient ratio and organic or peat-free status are attributes, brand product lines are lines rows (CV-46). Choice level provisional (no "best fertiliser" list fetched).

name: Pools & pool equipment
axis: Leaf axis: the function in the pool (the pool, water handling, heating, cleaning and covers, water treatment). Kind axis: pool form or equipment mechanism, by pool size or flow; pump speed class, filter area and cord length are attributes. All equipment and chemicals made for a swimming pool are here, in-ground pool or not (K-176).

name: Parts, accessories & consumables made for one machine
Growing plants
axis: Leaf axis: horticultural group as recognised by a register or trade department, by the ordered key below (the first test that fits wins; key order only breaks ties). Rooted in a medium and alive: potted, bare-root, plug plants, liners and rooted tissue-culture plantlets, and a plant in any container, basket, kokedama or terrarium (K-73). Kinds: canonical kind first, then by accepted botanical or crop name (memo section 8).

name: Tropical foliage & flowering plants (by genus list)

axis: Leaf axis: propagule type. Sold dry, dormant or unrooted, for planting (no roots and dormant = propagule); a seed sold as food is J5.

name: Fresh-cut plants
axis: Leaf axis: part cut. A stem, tree or arrangement of living plant material cut for display; dried, preserved and artificial ones are B4.

name: Living cultures & fungi
axis: Leaf axis: organism type (fungal spawn, ferment cultures, yeast and brewing cultures, algae cultures). A living culture kept to grow or propagate, even when what it makes is eaten.

axis: Leaf axis: device class as retailers shelve it (smartphones, feature phones, satellite phones, landline phones).

name: E-readers and pocket information devices
axis: Leaf axis: device class as retailers and museums shelve it.

axis: Leaf axis: device class as maker catalogues and expert guides separate it.

name: Film and slide projectors
axis: Kind axis: medium projected.

axis: Kind axis: what arrives and how.

name: Converters and headphone amplifiers
axis: Kind axis: function. `form` (desktop, dongle) is an attribute.

axis: Leaf axis: system role (speakers placed in a room; sound for a TV).

name: Soundbars and TV sound
axis: Kind axis: layout. Channel layout and format, Atmos, wall mounting and subwoofer included are attributes.

name: Headphones & earphones
axis: Leaf axis: where the transducer sits (outside the ear; in or at the ear). Driver technology (dynamic, planar, electrostatic, balanced armature, hybrid), wired or wireless, ANC, impedance, sensitivity, `transmitter_base` and `use` are attributes.

name: Headphones
axis: Kind axis: form and enclosure; headset by attached microphone.

name: Earphones
axis: Kind axis: wearing form. Driver setup and ANC are attributes.

name: All-in-one & complete systems
axis: Leaf axis: what is in one housing (music system; receiver for broadcasts).

name: Music systems
axis: Kind axis: what is in one housing.

name: Radios

axis: Kind axis: operation.
